prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 重点城市季度GDP增速对比表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "城市" spans 1 col × 2 row; "季度增速（%）" spans 4 col × 1 row; "说明" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "季度增速（%） › 一季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "季度增速（%） › 二季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "季度增速（%） › 三季度" · longest unbreakable word 23px · one-line width 46px
  col 5: header "季度增速（%） › 四季度" · longest unbreakable word 22px · one-line width 46px
  col 6: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 766px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较重点城市各季度GDP增速，并结合说明理解各城市的经济表现。","reading":"读者沿行查看同一城市的季度变化和说明，也会沿列比较各城市在同一季度的增速；说明文字较长，很可能主导各数据行的高度。","groups":["第一列城市名称用于定位整行。","第二至第五列都是季度增速，承担相同的比较功能，宜保持一致的视觉权重。","第六列说明为各城市的数值提供背景，与同一行的数据共同阅读。"],"keep_intact":["城市名称","季度增速数值及其小数点","百分号"],"may_wrap":["说明中的中文叙述可自然换行，并利用说明文字形成的行高。","季度子表头可换行，但应保持四个季度一致的处理方式。","跨四列的季度增速总表头在必要时可换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [52, 44, 44, 44, 44, 131] · table 360×1105px · row heights [36, 83, 199, 176, 153, 153, 153, 153] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [52, 48, 48, 48, 48, 115] · table 360×1244px · row heights [36, 83, 222, 199, 176, 176, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [52, 52, 52, 52, 52, 99] · table 360×1430px · row heights [36, 60, 269, 222, 199, 199, 222, 222] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"四个季度等宽，数值和城市名称保持完整，便于横向查看同城变化和纵向比较；说明栏在三个方案中最宽，叙述相对容易阅读。","problems":"季度子表头逐字分成三行，表头显得狭长；说明仍有较多换行，造成数据行很高，数值下方留下大片空白。","cause":"四个季度各44px，仅有23px内容宽度；说明栏131px，长段中文仍须分成多行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"季度列保持等宽，数值完整，列间留白稍有增加，比较关系清楚。","problems":"季度子表头依然逐字分成三行，增加的季度列宽没有改善表头换行；说明更窄，行更高，数据区空白也更显著。","cause":"季度列从44px增至48px，内容宽度仍不足以容纳两个汉字；说明栏相应缩至115px。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"四个季度仍等宽，子表头统一分为两行，比前两个方案更紧凑；数值和城市名称保持完整。","problems":"说明栏过窄，叙述频繁换行，阅读节奏破碎；数据行非常高，数值区大面积空白，使同一行的数据与说明之间的联系减弱。","cause":"季度列各52px，刚好改善子表头换行，但说明栏被压至99px，仅有78px内容宽度。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r1-说明优先","widths":[52,43,43,44,43,134],"change":"以r0A为基础，将季度列收至接近内容最小宽度，第三季度保留44px以容纳其23px的最长不可断内容；把节省的3px给说明栏。季度列只相差1px，仍保有近似一致的视觉权重，需检查数值是否完整以及说明换行是否改善。"}]}
